title: Schildi: Residenz Life
description: Experience the ultimate vanilla expansion at the Turtle Residence: Build together, discover new structures and enjoy true immersion thanks to Simple Voice Chat.
body:
# 🐢 Residence Life – The Official Modpack for the Turtle Residence

Welcome to **Residence Life**, the heart of our server network. This pack was specifically designed to preserve the classic Minecraft feel while massively expanding the possibilities for large-scale building projects and social interaction.

## ✨ Key Features

* **Better Vanilla:** We've optimized the gameplay with meaningful quality-of-life enhancements without losing the Minecraft charm.

* **Structure Update:** Discover a world full of new, detailed ruins, dungeons, and buildings that invite exploration and settlement.

* **Survival Building Project:** The focus is on collaborative creation. Whether monumental castles or cozy villages – teamwork is key here.

* **Group System:** Join forces with other players in groups to manage shared territories and realize large-scale projects.


## 🎙️ Immersion & Communication

For the perfect community experience, we're fully committed to **Simple Voice Chat**.

* **Proximity Audio:** Chat directly in-game with players nearby.

* **True Immersion:** No external tools required – communication feels natural and direct.

## 🛠️ Technical Details

This modpack is optimized for **performance** to ensure smooth gameplay, even during large building projects. We utilize state-of-the-art optimization mods to maintain stable FPS and minimize loading times.

---

**Become part of the residence:** Grab your friends, form a group, and build your legacy in the Turtle Residence!
